description: Human-Centered Design (HCD) is a design approach which puts people at the center of the design process. The goal of HCD is to understand the user’s context, needs and behaviors and create easy, convenient and pleasurable experiences. It requires a deep understanding of users' needs and a design team with a wide range of skills and diverse background.
